captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for 5 < pT < 10 GeV.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.9, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=18.039; The resulting scale factor is 0.9986 +/- 0.0026.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0.9 < |eta| < 1.2, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=4.127; The resulting scale factor is 1.0003 +/- 0.0032.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 1.2 < |eta| < 2.1, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=10.731; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.mass_fit_bin_03: Probe bin 2.1 < |eta| < 2.4, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=3.280; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties; bins without a valid fit are omitted. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for the single 5-10 GeV pT bin.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
